lessons.titleEn: part of the background of modern childhood
lessons.titleZh: 當代童年日常環境的一部分

target.pattern: \bpart of the background of modern childhood\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The internet is part of the background of modern childhood.
sources.expression: part of the background of modern childhood

brief.meaningEn: An ordinary, surrounding presence in a described contemporary childhood, rather than an occasional exceptional event.
brief.meaningZh: 在所描述的當代童年裏，是平常存在的周圍環境，而不只是偶然例外事件。
brief.grammar: Be part of the background of modern childhood. Background concerns the ordinary setting of life, not necessarily its least important influence. Bound broad claims with the actual people or account described.
brief.boundaryZh: 日常背景不等於所有兒童都有同樣接觸，也不表示沒有人留意或主動選擇。
brief.misconceptionZh: 日常背景不等於所有兒童都有同樣接觸，也不表示沒有人留意或主動選擇。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「當代童年日常環境的一部分」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 來源把互聯網視作童年日常環境；教學保留圖像，同時讓例句的觀察範圍明確。

listening.en: In the families described in the diary, online messages are part of the background of modern childhood: they arrange clubs and share homework questions, although the children’s access and interests differ.
listening.zh: 在日記描述的家庭裏，網上訊息是當代童年日常環境的一部分：它們用來安排學會及分享功課問題，但孩子的使用條件與興趣不同。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 日記寫到多種日常用途，也保留孩子之間的差異。
日記只記一次偶然使用，沒有日常安排。
每位孩子都已被確認有相同設備及興趣。
訊息只在學會取消後作一次通知，沒有參與平常安排。

listening.explanationZh: arrange/share 說平常存在，in families/differ 限定範圍，不概括所有孩子。

reply.promptEn: What does background mean in this diary’s description?
reply.promptZh: 日記這個描述中的「背景」指甚麼？

options.en: The messages are part of the background of modern childhood in these families, woven into ordinary arrangements.
options.zh: 在這些家庭，訊息融入平常安排，是當代童年日常環境的一部分。

options.en: They form part of the setting in which the described children organise their days.
options.zh: 它們是所描述孩子安排日常的環境一部分。

options.en: The emphasis is on repeated ordinary presence, not one exceptional encounter.
options.zh: 重點在反覆而平常的存在，不是一次例外接觸。

options.en: The account connects media with everyday life while recognising differences in access.
options.zh: 敘述把媒體跟日常生活連起來，也承認使用條件不同。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一項小調查只問到一位學生某次借電話查地址，沒有其他日常資料。摘要想把這當成所有學生共同的童年環境。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: One borrowed-phone lookup alone does not establish online access as part of the background of modern childhood for every student.
options.zh: 單是一次借電話查地址，不足以確立網絡使用是每位學生日常童年環境的一部分。

options.en: The survey documents repeated daily use across all the students’ homes.
options.zh: 調查記錄所有學生家庭每天反覆使用。

options.en: The single lookup establishes that the same arrangement surrounds the rest of each student’s day.
options.zh: 單次查找足以確立，每位學生其餘日常都有相同安排。

scene.explanationZh: 一次個別使用與廣泛平常環境不同，需要配合資料範圍。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 part of the background of modern childhood 得出？

options.en: 被描述為平常生活環境的一部分。
每位孩子必定有相同接觸方式和資源。
可再問描述的是哪些家庭及活動。

contrast.explanationZh: 平常環境的圖像仍需要範圍，不保證人人相同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說背景就是不重要，所以日記不必記那些訊息用途；你想保留日常作用。哪句最好？

options.en: Being part of the background of modern childhood can mean an ordinary presence, not an unimportant one; the arrangements still belong in this diary.
options.zh: 當代童年日常環境的一部分，可指平常存在，不是毫不重要；那些安排仍應記在日記中。

options.en: I thought background meant something that could have no effect on the activities described.
options.zh: 我原以為背景就指不可能影響所述活動的事。

options.en: I would count only unusual online events, leaving out the repeated uses that organise the day.
options.zh: 我只會計特別網絡事件，不看安排日常的反覆使用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 平常存在不等於沒有作用，正可透過日常用途理解。

speaking.en: The internet is part of the background of modern childhood in this account, but I want to hear how the children describe their own access and choices.
speaking.zh: 在這份敘述裏，互聯網是當代童年日常環境的一部分，但我想聽孩子自己怎樣描述使用條件及選擇。
speaking.promptZh: 向共同作者提出保留孩子個別敘述。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為童年生活展徵集家庭物件，除了相片也想收一份願意分享的日常安排記錄，例如紙本日程或刪去私人內容的訊息節錄。你想寫公開邀請，讓不同使用條件的家庭都能參與，不要求每家交手機截圖。用一至兩句英文寫實際邀請。

examples.en: Online communication may be part of the background of modern childhood, but our exhibition welcomes different records of daily arrangements, including paper schedules. Please choose something you are willing to share and remove personal details rather than feel required to submit a screenshot.
examples.zh: 網上溝通可能是當代童年日常環境的一部分，但展覽歡迎不同日常安排記錄，包括紙本日程。請選願意分享的物件並刪去私人資料，不用覺得必須交截圖。

examples.en: To explore what is part of the background of modern childhood, we invite families to contribute a record of an ordinary day in a form that suits them. A paper timetable is as welcome as an edited message extract, and participation is optional.
examples.zh: 為了解當代童年日常環境包括甚麼，我們邀家庭以合適形式提供一份普通日子的記錄。紙本時間表跟刪改後的訊息節錄一樣受歡迎，參與亦屬自願。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用實際徵集邀請接納不同家庭記錄方式，保留自願和私隱；不把媒體日常背景當成人人必交相同設備資料。

takeaways.en: The essay treats shared online calendars as part of the background of modern childhood in the homes it describes, alongside paper notes and family conversations.
takeaways.zh: 文章把共用網上日曆視為所述家庭童年環境的一部分，也同時寫紙本便條及家庭談話。

takeaways.en: Calling it part of the background of modern childhood led the interviewer to ask about ordinary routines, not only memorable first encounters with a device.
takeaways.zh: 把它稱為當代童年日常環境的一部分，令訪問者問平常習慣，不只問第一次接觸設備的難忘經驗。

lessons.titleZh: 對科技有興趣或較熟悉的

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The child is tech-minded.

brief.meaningEn: Interested in technology or inclined to engage comfortably with it, not necessarily highly trained in every technical skill.
brief.meaningZh: 對科技感興趣，或傾向樂於接觸、較熟悉科技，不一定精通每項技術。
brief.grammar: Be/seem tech-minded; a tech-minded learner. Compound adjective. Describe observed interest or approach rather than treating it as proof of an inborn or complete ability.
brief.boundaryZh: 興趣不等於已掌握特定工具，也不保證只喜歡科技活動；仍應問本人想做甚麼。
brief.misconceptionZh: 興趣不等於已掌握特定工具，也不保證只喜歡科技活動；仍應問本人想做甚麼。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「對科技有興趣或較熟悉的」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The tutor called Mei tech-minded because she enjoyed exploring how the audio app worked. Mei still asked for help exporting the recording, and also chose drawing for her other project.
listening.zh: 導師說Mei對科技有興趣，因她喜歡探索錄音程式怎樣運作。Mei仍需要問怎樣匯出錄音，另一項目也選了畫畫。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: Mei有科技興趣，但仍需學特定操作，也有別的興趣。
Mei已能獨立完成程式的所有功能。
Mei拒絕接觸錄音，只想看其他人操作。
導師主要因為Mei已熟悉匯出步驟，才形容她對科技有興趣。

listening.explanationZh: enjoyed exploring/asked help/also drawing 分清興趣、具體能力及其他選擇。

reply.promptEn: Why did the tutor call Mei tech-minded?
reply.promptZh: 導師為甚麼說Mei對科技有興趣？

options.en: She seemed tech-minded because she enjoyed finding out how the audio app worked.
options.zh: 她喜歡了解錄音程式怎樣運作，所以看來對科技有興趣。

options.en: Her curiosity about the app gave the tutor a reason to describe that interest.
options.zh: 她對程式的好奇，給導師描述那種興趣的理由。

options.en: She was willing to explore the tool even while learning an unfamiliar function.
options.zh: 她仍在學不熟悉功能，也願意探索工具。

options.en: The tutor noticed her interest in exploring the app, even though she still needed help with exporting.
options.zh: 導師留意到她喜歡探索程式，即使她仍需協助匯出錄音。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生很會使用一套舊軟件，但明說不喜歡探索科技，只為完成指定工作而學。作者只因她操作快，就要確定她對科技有廣泛興趣。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: Skill with one program alone does not establish that she is tech-minded in the sense of a broader interest in technology.
options.zh: 單是熟用一套程式，不足以確立她在廣泛科技興趣的意思上是tech-minded。

options.en: The account describes her seeking new tools for the pleasure of exploring them.
options.zh: 敘述說她為享受探索而尋找新工具。

options.en: Her speed proves she has chosen technology as her main interest outside the task.
options.zh: 她操作快，證明她已把科技選為任務以外的主要興趣。

scene.explanationZh: 操作能力與自述興趣不同，不只以速度替她決定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜只由 tech-minded 得出？

options.en: 對科技有興趣或傾向樂於接觸。
已精通這次任務需要的每項軟件功能。
仍可詢問本人熟悉哪些工具。

contrast.explanationZh: 傾向與興趣不是特定全面技能的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說Mei對科技有興趣，就把未問過的網站維護全派給她；你想先問技能及意願。哪句最好？

options.en: Being tech-minded does not mean Mei has offered to maintain the site; could we ask what she knows and wants to do?
options.zh: 對科技有興趣，不表示Mei已提出維護網站；我們可否先問她會甚麼及想做甚麼？

options.en: I thought enjoying one app meant she would want responsibility for the website too.
options.zh: 我原以為喜歡一個程式，就表示她也想負責網站。

options.en: I would use her quick start with the recorder as confirmation that she already knows the maintenance tools.
options.zh: 我會把她很快開始用錄音程式，當成她已懂維護工具的確認。

dialogue.explanationZh: 興趣、具體技能和承擔意願需要分開確認。

speaking.en: I am tech-minded, but I would like to try the tool before promising that I can support everyone else with it.
speaking.zh: 我對科技有興趣，但答應能支援所有人使用前，想先試工具。
speaking.promptZh: 誠實交代興趣與尚待確認的能力。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校想為學生介紹不同社團，你很有興趣用感應器觀察植物，但未學寫程式，也喜歡園藝。你想私下問科學社可否先以觀察者試一次，再談會不會做技術角色。用一至兩句英文提出實際參與請求。

examples.en: I am tech-minded and curious about using sensors with plants, but I have not learnt to program them. Could I join one session as an observer before deciding whether a technical role would suit me?
examples.zh: 我對科技有興趣，也好奇怎樣用感應器觀察植物，但未學過為它們寫程式。我可否先以觀察者參加一次，再決定技術角色是否合適？

examples.en: Being tech-minded does not mean I am ready to run the sensors, though I would enjoy learning how the garden project uses them. Could I watch a session and ask questions before offering to take responsibility?
examples.zh: 我對科技有興趣，不表示已能操作感應器，但會喜歡了解園藝項目怎樣使用。我可否先旁觀一次並發問，再提出承擔責任？

writing.selfCheckZh: 直接提出有限試參與，清楚說興趣及未學部分，不以標籤代替能力，也不把旁觀當已答應維護。

takeaways.en: The tech-minded volunteer enjoyed testing the new display, while asking someone else to check the part she had not used before.
takeaways.zh: 對科技有興趣的義工喜歡試新展示，也請別人核對她未用過的部分。

takeaways.en: He was tech-minded without wanting every hobby to involve a screen, and kept his weekend sketching group.
takeaways.zh: 他對科技有興趣，卻不想每項興趣都用螢幕，也保留周末素描小組。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Adults may be driving this early exposure.

brief.meaningEn: Cause or strongly direct the previously described early exposure, here initial experience of an online tool.
brief.meaningZh: 促成或強力推動前文所述的早期接觸；這裏指首次接觸網上工具的經驗。
brief.grammar: Adults may be driving this early exposure. Driving is the participle of drive; this refers to an already named experience. May marks a possible cause rather than established responsibility.
brief.boundaryZh: 造成接觸與兒童自發要求、持續使用及影響結果不同；需要因果資料，不只看最後誰在用。
brief.misconceptionZh: 造成接觸與兒童自發要求、持續使用及影響結果不同；需要因果資料，不只看最後誰在用。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「促成這種早期接觸」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: In the class account, adults may be driving this early exposure to online maps: the teacher introduces the tool before most pupils ask for it. We would need more than one class to describe a wider pattern.
listening.zh: 在這份課堂敘述中，成人可能正促成這種早期網上地圖接觸：大部分學生未主動要求前，老師已介紹工具。描述較廣模式仍需要不只一班。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 老師先介紹工具，支持這班由成人促成接觸的可能，未概括所有班。
學生已全在老師介紹前自行找到相同工具。
這一班已足以證明所有家庭的接觸原因相同。
敘述只記後來測驗成績，沒有介紹工具的過程。

listening.explanationZh: teacher introduces before ask 提供本次主動者線索，may/one class 保留範圍。

reply.promptEn: Why might adults be initiating the first contact in this class?
reply.promptZh: 為甚麼這班可能是成人先帶來接觸？

options.en: Adults may be driving this early exposure because the teacher introduces the map before most pupils request it.
options.zh: 老師在大部分學生要求前介紹地圖，所以成人可能正促成這種早期接觸。

options.en: The stated sequence puts the teacher’s introduction before the pupils’ requests.
options.zh: 所述先後把老師介紹放在學生要求之前。

options.en: The account gives an adult-led first step, rather than only observing later use.
options.zh: 敘述給出成人主導的起步，不只是觀察後來使用。

options.en: The teacher’s earlier introduction gives some support for an adult-led beginning within that class.
options.zh: 老師較早作介紹，為這班由成人主導起步的解釋提供部分支持。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生先自行提出想看數碼地圖，老師其後才回應示範。摘要只因老師示範過，就稱成人最先促成興趣。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: The teacher’s later help does not establish adults driving this early exposure before the pupils’ own request.
options.zh: 老師後來的協助，不足以確立成人在學生自行要求前，便先促成早期接觸。

options.en: The account says the teacher introduced the idea before any student mentioned it.
options.zh: 敘述說老師在學生提起前，先介紹想法。

options.en: The later demonstration identifies the adult as the source of the earlier request.
options.zh: 後來示範足以確定，成人是較早要求的來源。

scene.explanationZh: 要保留誰先提出的已知先後，回應要求與首先引發不同。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 adults may be driving this early exposure 得出？

options.en: 成人可能參與促成前文那種接觸。
每個孩子後來的使用方式都已由成人完全決定。
可進一步查誰先提出及怎樣介紹。

contrast.explanationZh: may/early exposure 不報告全部後來行為或所有兒童的原因。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說只看見孩子用工具，就能知道是孩子自己先要的；你想問開始過程。哪句最好？

options.en: Adults may be driving this early exposure, so I would ask who first suggested the tool before deciding how the use began.
options.zh: 成人可能促成這種早期接觸，所以判斷使用怎樣開始前，我會問誰先提議工具。

options.en: I thought the person holding the device must also have been the first to request it.
options.zh: 我原以為拿設備的人，就必定是首先提出要求的人。

options.en: I would explain the first introduction from the final task result without asking about the sequence.
options.zh: 我會由最後任務結果解釋最初介紹，不問先後過程。

dialogue.explanationZh: 最後使用者與最初提議者不同，需要開始過程的資料。

speaking.en: Could adults be driving this early exposure, or did the children ask first? I would like to hear how the first session began.
speaking.zh: 會否是成人促成這種早期接觸，還是孩子先要求？我想聽第一次活動怎樣開始。
speaking.promptZh: 向訪問伙伴提出開始過程的兩種可能。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替檔案室籌備首次數碼目錄體驗，學生還未提出要用，是你們主動安排。你想向籌委提議在邀請寫清是可選的介紹，先讓學生選想查甚麼，不把成人安排宣傳成所有學生自發要求。用一至兩句英文寫實際籌備訊息。

examples.en: We will be driving this early exposure to the catalogue, so could the invitation make clear that the introduction is optional? I suggest letting students choose a question to explore rather than presenting our plan as something they all requested.
examples.zh: 我們將主動促成這種早期目錄接觸，所以邀請可否說清介紹屬自選？我建議讓學生選想探索的問題，不把我們計劃說成所有人都曾要求。

examples.en: Since we are driving this early exposure, I would like us to describe it as an invitation to try the archive, not a response to a request we have not received. Could students first tell us what they might like to look for?
examples.zh: 既然是我們主動促成這種早期接觸，我想把它說成試用檔案的邀請，不是回應尚未收到的要求。學生可否先告訴我們可能想找甚麼？

glossary.en: an invitation to try the archive

writing.selfCheckZh: 在實際籌備訊息中承認誰主動安排，保留學生自選內容及是否參與；不把成人計劃當學生已自發要求。

takeaways.en: The librarian may be driving this early exposure to the archive by showing pupils how to begin a search before they have used it at home.
takeaways.zh: 學生在家使用前，圖書館員已示範怎樣起步查找，所以可能正促成這種早期檔案接觸。

takeaways.en: We asked what was driving this early exposure to the new platform rather than infer the starting point from a later habit.
takeaways.zh: 我們問甚麼促成這種早期新平台接觸，不從後來習慣推斷起點。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Children need guidance about everything that comes with it.

brief.meaningEn: The relevant associated features, responsibilities, benefits or difficulties that accompany the previously named thing.
brief.meaningZh: 伴隨前文所指事物而來的相關特點、責任、好處或困難。
brief.grammar: Something and everything that comes with it. It needs a clear singular antecedent. Comes with means accompanies here; everything is broad and its relevant scope depends on context.
brief.boundaryZh: 不專指壞處，也不是表示所有可能細節都已查明；應具體說明連帶內容。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不專指壞處，也不是表示所有可能細節都已查明；應具體說明連帶內容。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「連帶而來的各種事情」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 自然關係子句結構，不把整句另列為不可變固定成語。

listening.en: I liked the idea of leading the club, but wanted to understand everything that comes with it, including arranging rooms and replying to members. Those tasks had not been mentioned in the first invitation.
listening.zh: 我喜歡帶領學會的想法，但想了解連帶而來的各種事情，包括安排房間及回覆成員；最初邀請沒有提那些工作。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者有興趣，也想先了解未提過的相關責任。
說話者已拒絕帶領角色，不想知道內容。
最初邀請已列明每項房間及回覆工作。
連帶內容只指可能得到的獎項，不包括任務。

listening.explanationZh: liked/but understand/includes 說興趣與了解責任並存，不只好處或壞處。

reply.promptEn: Why did you ask for more detail before taking the role?
reply.promptZh: 接受角色前，你為甚麼再問詳情？

options.en: I wanted to understand everything that comes with it, not only the attractive title.
options.zh: 我想了解連帶各種事情，不只吸引的職銜。

options.en: The first invitation had not explained the room and member-response duties.
options.zh: 最初邀請未解釋安排房間及回覆成員的責任。

options.en: I needed a clearer account of the work before making a commitment.
options.zh: 我需要較清楚工作內容，才作承諾。

options.en: Interest in leading did not tell me which other tasks I would be accepting.
options.zh: 有興趣帶領，不代表已知道還要接受哪些工作。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 展覽職務的邀請清楚列出可參加培訓，也列出每周的準備及回覆工作。讀者卻以為everything that comes with it只可指壞處，所以培訓機會不屬於連帶內容。哪句較準確？

options.en: Everything that comes with it can include the training opportunity as well as the weekly duties of this exhibition role.
options.zh: 這個展覽職務連帶而來的內容，可以包括培訓機會，也包括每周的責任。

options.en: The expression excludes the training because associated features must be disadvantages.
options.zh: 這個說法不包括培訓，因為連帶內容必須是壞處。

options.en: The invitation presents the training as a substitute for the weekly preparation and replies.
options.zh: 邀請把培訓說成可取代每周準備及回覆的安排。

scene.explanationZh: 連帶內容可有好處及責任，實際範圍由情境交代；本次邀請明確列出兩方面。

contrast.promptZh: everything that comes with it 最不宜直接理解成哪項？

options.en: 伴隨前文事物的相關內容。
只包括負面風險，沒有任何其他方面。
可按語境具體說明責任或好處。

contrast.explanationZh: 這個結構不限好壞，實際內容由語境決定。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你喜歡職銜，就已等於答應未提過的工作；你想先問清。哪句最好？

options.en: I am interested, but I still need to understand everything that comes with it before accepting the full role.
options.zh: 我有興趣，但接受整個角色前，仍需了解連帶各種事情。

options.en: I thought liking the title meant the rest of the duties no longer needed explaining.
options.zh: 我原以為喜歡職銜，就表示其餘職務不用解釋。

options.en: I assumed the title referred only to leading meetings, with the messages handled by someone else.
options.zh: 我以為職銜只指帶領會議，訊息會由其他人處理。

dialogue.explanationZh: 喜歡職銜不會自動交代未提過的責任；會議以外的準備及回覆由誰處理，也要先問清楚。

speaking.en: I like the proposal, but could we go through everything that comes with it, including the preparation and the follow-up work?
speaking.zh: 我喜歡提議，但我們可否看清所有連帶內容，包括準備及後續工作？
speaking.promptZh: 在接受提議前詢問工作範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你開始參加學校樂團，第一次演出很開心，卻也發現有等候、反覆排練和整理共用譜架的工作。你想寫信給舊友，坦誠描述這整段新經驗，既不只報喜，也不把辛苦說成後悔加入。用一至兩句英文寫實際近況。

examples.en: I am enjoying the orchestra and learning about everything that comes with it, from the first performance to waiting through rehearsals and putting the stands away. It is more work than I imagined, but that does not take away the pleasure of playing together.
examples.zh: 我享受樂團，也正在認識連帶各種事情：由首次演出，到排練時等候及收好譜架。工作比想像多，但不減少一起演奏的樂趣。

examples.en: Joining the orchestra has meant accepting everything that comes with it, including repeated practice as well as the excitement of performing. I wanted to tell you about both, rather than make the new experience sound either effortless or miserable.
examples.zh: 加入樂團代表接受連帶各種事情，包括反覆練習及演出的興奮。我想兩方面都告訴你，不把新經驗說成毫不費力，或只有痛苦。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用實際近況信同時交代樂趣與日常工作，不把連帶內容只當壞處，也不由工作較多推成已後悔。

takeaways.en: The exhibition offered a new opportunity, but she asked about everything that comes with it, from transport to taking the work down afterwards.
takeaways.zh: 展覽帶來新機會，但她先問由運送到完場拆卸的各種連帶內容。

takeaways.en: He enjoyed the new garden and was learning about everything that comes with it, including sharing tools and keeping the paths clear.
takeaways.zh: 他享受新花園，也正了解共用工具、保持通道暢通等連帶事情。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: People sometimes scroll to kill time.

brief.meaningEn: Occupy a period of otherwise unfilled time, often while waiting.
brief.meaningZh: 找事填補一段空檔，常是等候時打發時間。
brief.grammar: Kill time while waiting/until something happens. Killing/killed. It does not entail literally purposeless behaviour or an activity with no enjoyment; the immediate function is filling the interval.
brief.boundaryZh: 不必是浪費或壞事，也不能由在看短片就確定只為打發時間；要看目的。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不必是浪費或壞事，也不能由在看短片就確定只為打發時間；要看目的。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「打發等候時間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: We had twenty minutes before the coach arrived, so we played a word game to kill time. It was enjoyable, but we stopped when the driver called rather than treat finishing the game as the reason for the trip.
listening.zh: 旅遊巴到達前有二十分鐘，我們便玩字詞遊戲打發時間。遊戲有趣，但司機叫集合時就停下，沒有把完成遊戲當旅程目的。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 遊戲填補等車空檔，集合時便停止。
大家為完成遊戲而取消乘車。
字詞遊戲是旅程要完成的正式考核。
遊戲在等車前已是要按時完成的正式課業。

listening.explanationZh: before coach/so/stopped when called 說填補空檔，不等於沒有趣味或必須完成。

reply.promptEn: Why did you start the word game?
reply.promptZh: 你們為甚麼開始字詞遊戲？

options.en: We wanted to kill time while waiting for the coach.
options.zh: 我們想等旅遊巴時打發時間。

options.en: There was a short gap before departure that we chose to fill together.
options.zh: 出發前有一段短空檔，我們選擇一起填補。

options.en: The game occupied the wait, rather than being the main purpose of the trip.
options.zh: 遊戲填補等候，不是旅程主要目的。

options.en: We had some time before the driver called, and the game was an enjoyable way to spend it.
options.zh: 司機集合前有些時間，玩遊戲是有趣的度過方式。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生在看短片，但明說要找到排練中的一個動作示範，正記下那個動作出現的時間點。旁人只看畫面就說他在打發時間。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: Watching clips does not by itself establish that he is killing time; the account gives a specific rehearsal task.
options.zh: 看短片本身不確定他是在打發時間；敘述有特定排練任務。

options.en: The student says he has no task to complete and is simply waiting for the bus.
options.zh: 學生說沒有任務要完成，只在等巴士。

options.en: The times he records concern how long he has been waiting, rather than where the rehearsal movement appears.
options.zh: 他記下的時間是自己已等多久，不是排練動作在影片哪裏出現。

scene.explanationZh: 活動形式與當下目的不同，不能只因短片就判斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 kill time 得出？

options.en: 用活動填補一段空檔。
那項活動一定毫無樂趣或價值。
可交代等甚麼，以及何時停止。

contrast.explanationZh: 打發時間描述用途，不自行評定活動沒有價值。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說只要玩得開心，就不能叫打發時間；你想說明等候用途。哪句最好？

options.en: We can enjoy the game and still use it to kill time until the coach arrives; those purposes do not conflict.
options.zh: 我們可享受遊戲，也用它打發等車時間；兩者不衝突。

options.en: I thought an enjoyable activity could not also fill a waiting period.
options.zh: 我原以為有趣活動不能同時填補等候。

options.en: I would treat finishing the game as more important than leaving when the driver calls.
options.zh: 我會把完成遊戲看成比司機叫集合時出發更重要。

dialogue.explanationZh: 樂趣與填補空檔可同時存在，仍可按主要安排停止。

speaking.en: We could play one quick round to kill time, if you feel like it, and stop when our number is called.
speaking.zh: 如果你想，我們可玩一輪打發時間，叫到號碼時便停。
speaking.promptZh: 向正在等候的朋友提出可選的小活動。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你在候車室等另一班車，朋友帶了素描本，你沒有。你想禮貌借一小頁紙，畫一個眼前物件打發十五分鐘，也說若朋友要自己用就沒問題，不要求完成正式作品。用一至兩句英文提出請求。

examples.en: Could I borrow one small sheet to sketch something and kill time before the train arrives? It is only a short wait, and please say if you need the paper yourself.
examples.zh: 火車到達前，我可借一小頁紙，畫點東西打發時間嗎？只是一小段等候；如果你要自己用紙，請告訴我。

examples.en: I would like to kill time with a quick sketch during these fifteen minutes; would you have a spare sheet I could use? There is no problem if you need it, and I will stop when we have to board.
examples.zh: 我想在這十五分鐘畫小速寫打發時間；你有一小頁多出的紙可讓我用嗎？如果你需要就沒問題，上車時我會停下。

writing.selfCheckZh: 禮貌請求可拒絕的少量物品，交代空檔及停止時機；不要求正式成果，也不把打發時間當朋友必須供應紙張的理由。

takeaways.en: She killed time in the waiting room by drawing the view, then put the sketch away when her appointment was called.
takeaways.zh: 她在等候室畫眼前景物打發時間，叫到預約時便收起速寫。

takeaways.en: They were killing time between performances, not ignoring a task they had agreed to finish.
takeaways.zh: 他們在兩場演出之間打發時間，不是在忽略已答應完成的任務。

lessons.titleZh: 如巨大商業街般的網上空間

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The platform feels like a giant digital high street.

brief.meaningEn: A large online space offering varied activities, services or shops, compared with a busy main shopping street.
brief.meaningZh: 把提供多種活動、服務或商店的大型網上空間，比作繁忙的主要商業街。
brief.grammar: A platform feels like/acts as a giant digital high street. High street is a British term for a town’s main shopping street; giant emphasises scale. Explain which digital uses support the image.
brief.boundaryZh: 多用途不等於所有商店都可信或功能毫無差別，也不是每次登入都在購物。
brief.misconceptionZh: 多用途不等於所有商店都可信或功能毫無差別，也不是每次登入都在購物。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「如巨大商業街般的網上空間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 整句是平台多用途的創意城市圖像，不作固定成語教學。

listening.en: The reviewer called the platform a giant digital high street because users could browse local shops, find events and meet community groups there. She still compared the individual services instead of treating them as equally reliable.
listening.zh: 評論者把平台比作巨大的網上商業街，因使用者可逛本地商店、找活動及接觸社區小組；她仍分別比較各服務，不把它們當同樣可靠。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 平台集合不同用途，但各服務仍需分別了解。
評論者已確認每個商店都有同樣質素。
平台只提供一次指定活動，沒有其他用途。
評論者只按商店數目作比較，沒有提活動或社區小組。

listening.explanationZh: shops/events/groups 提供商業街多用途線索，still compare 保留各服務差異。

reply.promptEn: Why did the reviewer compare the platform with a high street?
reply.promptZh: 評論者為甚麼把平台比作商業街？

options.en: It felt like a giant digital high street because it brought shops, events and community groups into one online space.
options.zh: 它把商店、活動和社區小組放在一處網上空間，所以像巨大的網上商業街。

options.en: Users could move between several kinds of activity rather than visit only one service.
options.zh: 使用者可在幾種活動之間轉換，不只用單一服務。

options.en: The image described the variety and scale of the things people could find there.
options.zh: 圖像描述可找到的事物有多大規模及多樣。

options.en: It offered a way to describe the range without claiming every service was the same.
options.zh: 它能描述用途範圍，不必聲稱每項服務相同。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一個頁面只有已定活動的單張時間表，不能瀏覽商店或參加小組。作者只因頁面人多看，就稱它多用途商業街。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: A large audience alone does not establish a giant digital high street when the account gives only one timetable function.
options.zh: 敘述只有時間表功能時，單是觀眾多，不能確立它如巨大網上商業街。

options.en: The page is described as offering shopping and community conversations alongside the timetable.
options.zh: 頁面被描述為在時間表以外，也提供購物和社區談話。

options.en: The number of visitors identifies a range of services even without any description of them.
options.zh: 即使沒有服務描述，訪客數目也足以確定有多種用途。

scene.explanationZh: 人多與用途多不同，這個圖像需實際功能範圍支持。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a giant digital high street 得出？

options.en: 網上空間被比作集合不同用途的商業街。
平台內每一項服務都已證實同樣可靠。
可以說明哪些用途讓圖像貼切。

contrast.explanationZh: 街道圖像描述範圍，不保證各店或服務品質。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說像商業街就代表每次登入都是買東西；你想保留社區用途。哪句最好？

options.en: A giant digital high street can include events and conversations as well as shops; we should describe what the person actually did.
options.zh: 巨大網上商業街可有活動及談話，也有商店；我們應描述本人實際做甚麼。

options.en: I thought meeting a community group there was another way of placing an order.
options.zh: 我原以為在那裏接觸社區小組，也是另一種下單方式。

options.en: I assumed the event section was advertising for the shops rather than a separate community use.
options.zh: 我以為活動區只是替商店宣傳，不是另一種社區用途。

dialogue.explanationZh: 商業街圖像可涵蓋不同用途，實際行動需由情境決定。

speaking.en: It feels like a giant digital high street, but I want to compare the services I need rather than assume the whole platform works in one way.
speaking.zh: 它像巨大的網上商業街，但我想比較所需服務，不假定整個平台只以一種方式運作。
speaking.promptZh: 介紹平台時保留各項服務差異。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你為新居民寫網上社區入口的使用導言。它有本地修理店名錄、社團活動及公開討論區，但三區各有聯絡方式。你想用商業街圖像邀讀者按目的選區，再看該區說明，不把三區寫成同一商店。用一至兩句英文寫實際導言。

examples.en: Think of this page as a giant digital high street, with a repair directory, events and a discussion area. Choose the section that fits your purpose and read its contact details, rather than assume one message reaches every service.
examples.zh: 可把這頁想成巨大的網上商業街，有修理名錄、活動及討論區。請按目的選區並看該區聯絡資料，不要假定一則訊息會到達每項服務。

examples.en: This is a giant digital high street rather than a single shop: the directory, event listings and discussion area do different jobs. Start with what you need, then check how that section asks you to make contact.
examples.zh: 這是巨大的網上商業街，不是單一商店：名錄、活動表及討論區各有用途。先按自己需要選擇，再查該區怎樣聯絡。

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫可用的入口導言，讓圖像幫助分區選擇及查聯絡方式；不把多用途混成同一服務或作全面品質保證。

takeaways.en: Her essay presents the portal as a giant digital high street where finding a concert is a different activity from ordering a book.
takeaways.zh: 她的文章把入口比作巨大網上商業街，找音樂會與訂書是不同活動。

takeaways.en: The platform became a giant digital high street in his account, but he still explained which part he used to contact the local group.
takeaways.zh: 他的敘述把平台比作巨大網上商業街，但仍交代用哪一區聯絡地方小組。

sources.sentence: He uses his phone for getting things done.

brief.meaningEn: Complete practical tasks or make useful progress on them, with context specifying the actual work.
brief.meaningZh: 完成實際任務，或讓事情取得有用進展；具體工作由上下文說明。
brief.grammar: Get things done; getting things done; got things done. Get + object + past participle is a result construction here, not a claim that every task is complete.
brief.boundaryZh: 忙碌、開很多頁面或回覆數量，不一定代表實際目標已達；也不表示不能休息。
brief.misconceptionZh: 忙碌、開很多頁面或回覆數量，不一定代表實際目標已達；也不表示不能休息。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把實際事情完成」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: I used the quiet hour for getting things done: I sent the two forms that were ready and noted which attachment I still needed. Opening every unfinished file would have made me look busy without finishing the urgent submissions.
listening.zh: 我用安靜的一小時完成實際事情：寄出兩份已準備好的表格，記下仍缺哪個附件。把每個未完檔案都打開，看來忙碌，卻未必完成急需提交的工作。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者完成兩份可提交表格，也保留缺附件的工作。
所有未完任務都已在一小時內完成。
說話者只開檔案，沒有寄出任何表格。
缺少附件的表格也被確認已完整提交。

listening.explanationZh: sent two/noted still needed 分開實際完成及剩餘缺口，不以看來忙代替成果。

reply.promptEn: What did the quiet hour allow you to do?
reply.promptZh: 安靜的一小時讓你做到甚麼？

options.en: I could get things done by sending the ready forms and identifying the missing attachment.
options.zh: 我寄出已備妥表格，並指出缺少附件，讓實際事情有進展。

options.en: Two urgent submissions moved forward instead of remaining among many open files.
options.zh: 兩項急需提交的工作有進展，不再只是很多開着的檔案之一。

options.en: I finished what was ready and made the next information need clear.
options.zh: 我完成已準備的部分，也釐清下一項資料需要。

options.en: The hour produced completed actions and a specific remaining question.
options.zh: 那一小時帶來已完成行動，以及一個具體未解問題。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 木工小組未開始切木，先完成尺寸核對，解決了兩幅圖不一致的問題，現在可以按同一份尺寸施工。有人只因桌子未完成，就說他們甚麼也沒做。哪句較準確？

options.en: They did get things done by settling the conflicting measurements, even though the table has not been built yet.
options.zh: 雖然桌子還未造好，他們已解決尺寸矛盾，確實完成了有用的工作。

options.en: The account reports that the measurements remain inconsistent and nobody has checked the drawings.
options.zh: 敘述說尺寸仍有矛盾，而且沒有人核對圖紙。

options.en: The team’s preparation is described as the completed construction of the table.
options.zh: 小組的準備被描述為已完成整張桌子的施工。

scene.explanationZh: 核對尺寸及解決矛盾是已完成的必要準備，不用等整張桌子造好才算有實際進展。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 get things done 得出？

options.en: 有實際事情完成或取得進展。
所有清單項目都已完成，不可能仍有待查部分。
可再說明完成哪些行動。

contrast.explanationZh: 泛指有用進展，不自動宣稱全部工作完結。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你還缺一個附件，就等於那一小時甚麼也沒做；你已寄出兩份表格。哪句最好？

options.en: I did get things done by sending the ready forms, while the missing attachment remains a separate next step.
options.zh: 我確實寄出備妥表格，完成了實際事情，而缺附件仍是另一項下一步。

options.en: I thought one unfinished item meant none of the completed actions counted as progress.
options.zh: 我原以為一項未完，就表示已完成行動全不算進展。

options.en: I thought identifying the missing attachment meant that last submission was complete too.
options.zh: 我原以為指出缺哪個附件，就表示最後一項提交也已完成。

dialogue.explanationZh: 承認部分進展也保留未完部分，不用全有或全無描述。

speaking.en: I want to get things done, so could we name the next action and the information still missing rather than simply open another file?
speaking.zh: 我想讓實際事情有進展，所以可否指明下一行動及仍缺資料，而不只再開檔案？
speaking.promptZh: 邀請伙伴把忙碌轉成具體下一步。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：週末你跟室友只剩半小時整理共用客廳。兩人同意先清空走道，再把待認領物品放入一個標示箱；私人抽屜各自之後處理。你要在群組提出兩步合作邀請，讓可完成範圍清楚，不要求今晚整理全屋。用一至兩句英文寫實際提議。

examples.en: We can get things done in this half-hour by clearing the walkway and putting unclaimed items in one labelled box. Could we do those two shared tasks now and leave our private drawers for another time?
examples.zh: 我們可在這半小時清空走道，把待認領物品放進一個標示箱，完成實際事情。現在可否一起做這兩項共用工作，私人抽屜另擇時間處理？

examples.en: Let’s get things done without trying to sort the whole flat tonight: first clear the shared path, then use a labelled box for the items still awaiting an owner. We can each deal with our own drawers later.
examples.zh: 今晚不用試着整理全屋，也讓實際事情有進展：先清共用通道，再用標示箱放仍待認領物品。各人的抽屜稍後自行處理。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出兩項有界線的共同成果及先後安排，尊重私人部分；不把有進展當全屋已整好，也不只說大家忙起來。

takeaways.en: The group got things done once each person knew which reply they were responsible for sending.
takeaways.zh: 每人知道負責寄哪份回覆後，小組把實際事情完成了。

takeaways.en: Getting things done meant asking for the missing measurement before building, not pretending the unanswered question had disappeared.
takeaways.zh: 讓事情有進展，這次是動工前詢問缺少尺寸，不是假裝未解問題消失。

lessons.titleEn: part office, part classroom, and part marketplace
lessons.titleZh: 兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能

target.pattern: \bpart office, part classroom, and part marketplace\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The portal is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace.
sources.expression: part office, part classroom, and part marketplace

brief.meaningEn: A platform serves several roles, compared with an office, learning space and place for exchange or trade.
brief.meaningZh: 平台同時發揮幾種作用，比作辦公室、學習空間及交易或交換的市集。
brief.grammar: Be part office, part classroom, and part marketplace. Part X, part Y is a mixed-function pattern, not measured fractions; give each comparison a concrete use.
brief.boundaryZh: 功能並存不等於完全相同，也不保證每項服務都有相同規則；不是三者各佔精確三分一。
brief.misconceptionZh: 功能並存不等於完全相同，也不保證每項服務都有相同規則；不是三者各佔精確三分一。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 整組為平台用途的創意並列比喻，不當作不可改動的固定成語。

listening.en: Our portal is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace: we submit club forms, join a lesson and exchange spare materials there. Each area still has its own instructions and contact person.
listening.zh: 我們的入口兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能：可交學會表格、上課，也交換多出物料；每區仍有自己的指示和聯絡人。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 平台有三類用途，各區規則與聯絡仍分開。
三類用途被確認每類剛好佔三分一時間。
一區的聯絡人已答應代處理所有交易及課程。
入口只收表格，課程及交換都在另一網站。

listening.explanationZh: forms/lesson/exchange 分別支持圖像，own instructions 保留不同安排。

reply.promptEn: What does the three-part comparison tell us about the portal?
reply.promptZh: 三部分的比較，告訴我們入口有甚麼特點？

options.en: It is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace because it combines forms, learning and material exchange.
options.zh: 它結合表格、學習及物料交換，所以兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能。

options.en: It supports several purposes rather than only a single type of activity.
options.zh: 它支援幾種目的，不只是單一類活動。

options.en: Each image names a different use that people can find in the same portal.
options.zh: 每個圖像都指出在同一入口可找到的一種不同用途。

options.en: The mixed description does not remove the separate instructions for each area.
options.zh: 混合描述沒有取消各區不同的指示。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 報道只知道網站有討論課程及交表格，沒有買賣或交換功能。作者想照用完整三部分圖像。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: Part office and part classroom fit the stated uses, but part office, part classroom, and part marketplace would add an exchange role not yet described.
options.zh: 辦公室及課室符合已述用途，但完整三部分圖像會加上尚未描述的交換角色。

options.en: The account explicitly includes a section where users trade spare materials.
options.zh: 敘述明確包括使用者交易多出物料的專區。

options.en: Having forms and lessons establishes that purchases must take place on the same site too.
options.zh: 有表格和課堂，就足以確定同站也一定有購買。

scene.explanationZh: 每個部分都要有語境支持，不能因有兩種就自行補上第三種。

contrast.promptZh: part office, part classroom, and part marketplace 最不宜直接表示哪項？

options.en: 結合不同用途的圖像。
三種用途各精確佔三分一，已經量度。
可逐項指出實際功能。

contrast.explanationZh: part 並列不給精確比例。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說三種功能在同站，就可用同一規則處理所有資料；你想先看各區要求。哪句最好？

options.en: It can be part office, part classroom, and part marketplace while each area still needs its own clear instructions.
options.zh: 它可兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，各區也仍需清楚的各自指示。

options.en: I thought one shared address meant the booking form and exchange area had identical requirements.
options.zh: 我原以為共用網址，就表示預約表格和交換區有相同要求。

options.en: I assumed the lesson organiser also handled the exchange enquiries because both areas share the same site.
options.zh: 我以為兩區共用網站，所以課程統籌人也處理交換查詢。

dialogue.explanationZh: 共用平台與同一規則、同一職責不同，應按功能確認。

speaking.en: It is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace, so our guide should tell people which section handles each request.
speaking.zh: 它兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，所以指引應告訴大家各類要求由哪區處理。
speaking.promptZh: 向編輯提出按用途寫入口指引。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替老師核對自己的網上學習日記，原稿把在學校入口的一小時全記成上課，其實十五分鐘交表、三十分鐘上課、十五分鐘交換二手書。你想用多用途圖像更正記錄，不把同站的所有時間當同一活動。用一至兩句英文寫實際更正。

examples.en: The portal is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace, so my hour there was not all lesson time. I spent fifteen minutes on forms, thirty in the lesson and fifteen exchanging books; please record those activities separately.
examples.zh: 入口兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，所以我在那裏一小時不是全在上課。我用十五分鐘交表、三十分鐘上課、十五分鐘交換書本；請把活動分開記錄。

examples.en: Because the site is part office, part classroom, and part marketplace, its total use does not identify one activity. My diary should show half an hour of learning, with the other half split between forms and the book exchange.
examples.zh: 網站兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，總使用時間不能確定是同一活動。日記應記半小時學習，另外半小時分為交表和換書。

writing.selfCheckZh: 用實際時間及用途更正日記，不由同一網址把所有活動算作上課，也不把其他用途判為無意義。

takeaways.en: The writer called the site part office, part classroom, and part marketplace, then explained a different task under each heading.
takeaways.zh: 作者把網站稱為兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，再在每個標題下解釋不同任務。

takeaways.en: The portal felt part office, part classroom, and part marketplace to the members, but they still wanted a clearer route to the right contact.
takeaways.zh: 成員覺得入口兼具辦公室、課室和市集功能，但仍想有較清楚途徑找合適聯絡人。

sources.sentence: She watches clips to pass the time.

brief.meaningEn: Occupy a period of time with an activity, often while waiting or relaxing.
brief.meaningZh: 以活動度過一段時間，常在等候或放鬆時。
brief.grammar: Pass the time doing/with something; passed/passing. Related kill time has a similar waiting-time use; this is a different lexical expression, not a newly invented sense.
brief.boundaryZh: 不自行表示浪費、沒有樂趣或已忽略責任；也不是正式完成任務的同義詞。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不自行表示浪費、沒有樂趣或已忽略責任；也不是正式完成任務的同義詞。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「找事消磨一段時間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: She passed the time on the long journey by listening to stories she already knew. She was not studying for a test; the familiar voices made the hours pleasant, and she paused them when the station was announced.
listening.zh: 長途旅程中，她聽已熟悉的故事消磨時間。她不是為考試讀書；熟悉聲音讓時間愉快，報站時她便暫停。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 故事陪她愉快度過旅程，報站時仍有留意。
她聽故事只為完成已指定考試。
她因聽故事而拒絕在到站時下車。
她主要想聽新故事內容，熟悉的聲音並非旅途樂趣的一部分。

listening.explanationZh: not studying/pleasant/paused 說旅途用途，不是正式任務或必然失去注意。

reply.promptEn: Why did she listen to familiar stories on the journey?
reply.promptZh: 她在旅程中為甚麼聽熟悉故事？

options.en: They helped her pass the time pleasantly during the long journey.
options.zh: 它們幫她愉快消磨長途旅程的時間。

options.en: The voices made the hours more enjoyable without being a test task.
options.zh: 聲音讓時間較好過，不是考試任務。

options.en: She chose a familiar activity to accompany the trip.
options.zh: 她選熟悉活動陪伴旅程。

options.en: Her purpose was to occupy the journey, not to produce study notes.
options.zh: 她是想度過旅程，不是製作溫習筆記。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 旅客讀一段說明書，為到場後立即裝好展示架，並核對缺少零件。旁人只因在車上讀，就稱純粹消磨時間。哪句較準確？

options.en: Reading on a journey does not by itself show an intention merely to pass the time; the account gives a practical preparation task.
options.zh: 旅途中閱讀，本身不能顯示只為消磨時間；敘述有實際準備任務。

options.en: The traveller says there is no task to prepare and chooses a familiar story just for the wait.
options.zh: 旅客說無任務要準備，只為等候而選熟悉故事。

options.en: The manual is being read for general interest, with no intention of using it to prepare the assembly.
options.zh: 他只是出於一般興趣看說明書，沒有打算用它準備組裝。

scene.explanationZh: 地點不決定活動目的，需要看本人實際在準備甚麼。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜只由 pass the time 得出？

options.en: 用某項活動度過一段時間。
已證明浪費時間並忽略約定責任。
可以進一步說明活動及等候情境。

contrast.explanationZh: 表達本身不作這種負面評價。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說沒有考核目的就不值得聽故事；你想說旅程也可愉快度過。哪句最好？

options.en: A story can help me pass the time pleasantly without needing to become a study task; I can still listen for my stop.
options.zh: 故事可讓我愉快消磨時間，不必變溫習任務；我也仍可留意到站。

options.en: I thought enjoyment during a journey counted only if it produced notes for later assessment.
options.zh: 我原以為旅途中樂趣，只有能產生考核筆記才算數。

options.en: I assumed the story was mainly preparation for a discussion after the journey, rather than something pleasant for the ride.
options.zh: 我以為聽故事主要是準備旅程後的討論，不是為了愉快度過車程。

dialogue.explanationZh: 故事可以只是愉快度過旅程的活動，不必另有考核或準備討論的任務，也仍可留意報站。

speaking.en: We can pass the time with a quiet conversation if you like, but there is no need to fill every pause.
speaking.zh: 如果你想，我們可安靜聊聊消磨時間，但不必填滿每個停頓。
speaking.promptZh: 尊重朋友選擇安靜或談話。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：住在外地的朋友說休息日很長，想聽你推薦可隨時停下的小活動。你想邀他用自己熟悉的舊相片，寫一兩句願意保留的回憶，不要求公開或做成完整相簿，也不替他斷定獨處難受。用一至兩句英文提出可選的個人活動。

examples.en: If you would enjoy it, you could pass the time with an old photograph and a sentence about a memory you want to keep. It need not become a finished album or something you share with anyone.
examples.zh: 如果你覺得有趣，可看一張舊相片，寫一句想保留的回憶來消磨時間。不必變完整相簿，也不用跟任何人分享。

examples.en: One way to pass the time might be to choose a familiar photo and write just a few words for yourself. You can stop whenever you want, and there is no need to post it or turn the day into a project.
examples.zh: 消磨時間的一個方法，或是選熟悉相片，只為自己寫幾個字。你可隨時停，不用發布，也不必把休息日變項目。

glossary.en: a memory you want to keep
just a few words for yourself

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出可停、可拒絕、不要求公開或成果的小活動；不把消磨時間等同浪費，也不假定朋友必須避免獨處。

takeaways.en: They passed the time between visits by comparing the sketches they had made, then left when the next session opened.
takeaways.zh: 兩次到訪之間，他們比較各自速寫消磨時間，下節開放便出發。

takeaways.en: He chose a short story to pass the time while waiting for the room, not because anyone had assigned it.
takeaways.zh: 他選短故事消磨等房間的時間，不是因任何人指定。

sources.sentence: The app acts as a digital meeting place.

brief.meaningEn: An online space where people can make contact and interact.
brief.meaningZh: 讓人們建立聯絡及互動的網上空間。
brief.grammar: An app acts as/is a digital meeting place for a group. Meeting place represents social function, not necessarily a live scheduled call or public access for everyone.
brief.boundaryZh: 有交流空間不表示每人同時在場、已熟悉或同意公開內容；應交代實際參與方式。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有交流空間不表示每人同時在場、已熟悉或同意公開內容；應交代實際參與方式。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「網上交流聚會空間」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The forum became a digital meeting place for former classmates, who left memories at different times rather than join one live call. Some read quietly, and nobody was required to post a personal story.
listening.zh: 論壇成了舊同學的網上交流空間，大家在不同時間留下回憶，不是參加同一通即時通話。有些人安靜閱讀，沒有要求誰必須寫私人故事。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 互動可不同步，也容許只讀而不發表私人故事。
所有舊同學都在同一時間開視像會議。
論壇要求每人先公開私人故事才可閱讀。
舊同學只收到靜態時間表，沒有任何互動空間。

listening.explanationZh: different times/read quietly 說不同步和可選參與，不由meeting假定即時通話。

reply.promptEn: How did the forum let former classmates meet?
reply.promptZh: 論壇讓舊同學怎樣交流？

options.en: It was a digital meeting place where they could leave memories at different times.
options.zh: 它是網上交流空間，大家可在不同時間留下回憶。

options.en: They could respond without arranging one time when everyone was free.
options.zh: 不用安排每人同時有空，也可回應。

options.en: The space supported contact while leaving posting optional.
options.zh: 空間支持聯絡，也保留可選發表。

options.en: Some could take part by reading without being asked for a private story.
options.zh: 有些人可透過閱讀參與，不被要求提供私人故事。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 網站只顯示一份舊班名單，沒有聯絡方式、留言或其他互動；評論想說它已形成活躍交流空間。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: A name list alone does not establish a digital meeting place for active contact; the account gives no way to interact.
options.zh: 單是姓名名單，不能確立活躍聯絡的網上交流空間；敘述沒有互動途徑。

options.en: The account says former classmates can leave and answer messages there.
options.zh: 敘述說舊同學可在那裏留言及回覆。

options.en: Keeping the names establishes that the people are already conversing online.
options.zh: 保留姓名足以確定，那些人已在網上交談。

scene.explanationZh: 記錄人名與建立互動不同，需要實際交流功能或行動。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a digital meeting place 得出？

options.en: 提供網上社交接觸的空間。
每位成員必定在同一刻參加視像通話。
可再交代留言或回應怎樣進行。

contrast.explanationZh: meeting place 說功能，不必是同步會議。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說交流空間有人只讀，就不算他們參與；你想保留自選方式。哪句最好？

options.en: A digital meeting place can allow reading as well as posting; we do not need everyone to share a personal story.
options.zh: 網上交流空間可容許閱讀及發表，不必要求每人分享私人故事。

options.en: I thought becoming a member meant a personal post was required before reading anything.
options.zh: 我原以為成為成員，就表示看內容前必須先寫私人貼文。

options.en: I assumed meeting meant joining a scheduled live conversation, so I did not count reading earlier posts.
options.zh: 我以為交流就是參加已安排時間的即時談話，所以沒有把閱讀較早貼文算進去。

dialogue.explanationZh: 交流可有不同步和不同程度的參與，不從名稱或會員身份加上要求。

speaking.en: Could we make it a digital meeting place where people choose when to read or reply, rather than expect an immediate answer?
speaking.zh: 我們可否把它做成讓人自選何時閱讀或回覆的網上交流空間，而不期待立即答覆？
speaking.promptZh: 向小組提議不同步而可選的交流安排。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩地學生合辦一次作品交流，時差令即時通話難約。你想先邀雙方在一個有範圍的留言區各放一張願意公開給伙伴看的作品，以及一個問題，定周五前回覆，不把個人帳號公開給全校。用一至兩句英文寫實際合作提議。

examples.en: Could a shared board act as a digital meeting place for our two groups across the time difference? We could each post one piece we are willing to show and one question, with replies by Friday and access limited to the partners.
examples.zh: 共用留言板可否作兩組跨時差的網上交流空間？我們可各放一件願意展示的作品及一個問題，周五前回覆，並限伙伴進入。

examples.en: Let’s use a digital meeting place for the artwork exchange rather than require a live call. I suggest one optional work and question from each person, a Friday reply deadline and no publication of personal accounts to the wider school.
examples.zh: 讓我們用網上交流空間交換作品，不要求即時通話。我建議每人自選一件作品及問題、定周五回覆期限，並不向全校公開私人帳號。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出配合時差的具體作品交流、期限及範圍，保留可選作品；不把交流空間當必須即時回應或公開私人帳號。

takeaways.en: The class newsletter linked to a digital meeting place where members could add questions before the next visit.
takeaways.zh: 班級通訊連到一個網上交流空間，讓成員下次到訪前加上問題。

takeaways.en: She valued a digital meeting place that kept contact possible without asking everyone to be present at one hour.
takeaways.zh: 她重視能保持聯絡、又不要求每人在同一小時在場的網上交流空間。

lessons.titleEn: dip in and out of it
lessons.titleZh: 不時短暫取用，再回來看

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: The course is flexible, so learners can dip in and out of it during the week.
sources.expression: dip in and out of it

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 139, row 6; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: You can dip in and out of the magazine over a week.

brief.meaningEn: Engage with a resource briefly at intervals, leaving and returning rather than using it continuously.
brief.meaningZh: 隔一段時間短暫使用某資源，離開再回來，不是一直連續進行。
brief.grammar: Dip in and out of a book, magazine, guide, course or other resource; a clear earlier referent permits “it”. Dipped/dipping. This is intermittent engagement, not literal movement in and out of a place or necessarily completion.
brief.register: Neutral everyday English; a reader may use it to describe returning to a magazine or reference book at intervals.
brief.boundaryZh: 短暫回來使用不保證已完成全課，也不表示一定不認真；需看資源設計及目的。
brief.misconceptionZh: 短暫回來使用不保證已完成全課，也不表示一定不認真；需看資源設計及目的。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「不時短暫取用，再回來看」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The reference course has short independent sections, so I dip in and out of it when a question comes up at work. I have used three sections carefully, but I would not say I have completed the whole course.
listening.zh: 參考課有短小而獨立的部分，所以工作有問題時，我會不時回來取用。我仔細用過三部分，但不會說已完成整課。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 說話者按需要間歇使用，未聲稱完成全部。
說話者已連續學完所有部分。
三部分都只是打開頁面，沒有仔細使用。
課程要求每次都由首頁不中斷讀到結尾。

listening.explanationZh: when question/three carefully/not completed 分開間歇形式、投入及完成範圍。

reply.promptEn: How do you use the reference course?
reply.promptZh: 你怎樣使用參考課？

options.en: I dip in and out of it when a work question makes a particular section useful.
options.zh: 工作問題令某部分有用時，我會不時回來取用。

options.en: I return to short sections at different times rather than take the whole course in one sitting.
options.zh: 我在不同時間回看短部分，不是一次完成整課。

options.en: The resource supports intermittent use for specific questions.
options.zh: 資源可按特定問題間歇使用。

options.en: My use is careful but selective, and does not amount to completing every section.
options.zh: 我仔細而有選擇地使用，不等於完成每部分。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 學生按要求連續看完一場含多個話題、不能暫停的直播，中途沒有離開或回看。旁白想用間歇取用描述這次過程。哪句較準確？

options.en: Watching the whole live session continuously is not, in this account, to dip in and out of it.
options.zh: 在這份敘述，連續看完整場直播，不是間歇離開再回來取用。

options.en: The account describes several brief returns to independent sections during the week.
options.zh: 敘述描述一周內幾次短暫回看獨立部分。

options.en: Moving between topics within the uninterrupted session is described as leaving the resource and returning on separate visits.
options.zh: 直播中話題轉換，被描述為離開資源後，另一次再回來取用。

scene.explanationZh: 一次連續觀看中轉換話題，不等於離開後分次回來使用；應按實際觀看過程判斷。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 I dip in and out of it 得出？

options.en: 我隔段時間短暫回來使用前文資源。
我已完成資源所有內容。
可再說明每次回來是為甚麼問題。

contrast.explanationZh: 取用方式不是全部完成的證明。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說你沒連續上整課，就不能說仔細用過其中章節；你想分形式與投入。哪句最好？

options.en: I can dip in and out of it and still study a chosen section carefully; I just should not claim to have completed everything.
options.zh: 我可間歷取用，也仔細讀所選部分；只是不能聲稱全已完成。

options.en: I thought careful use required every section to be read in a single sitting.
options.zh: 我原以為仔細使用，必須一次讀完每部分。

options.en: I assumed returning to the same section meant the other sections had already been covered.
options.zh: 我以為回看同一部分，就表示其他部分已經讀過了。

dialogue.explanationZh: 間歇與認真可並存，完成範圍仍應準確。

speaking.en: This handbook has independent entries, so you can dip in and out of it as questions arise rather than read it all at once.
speaking.zh: 這本手冊各條目獨立，所以有問題時可不時回來取用，不必一次全讀完。
speaking.promptZh: 向新成員介紹手冊的取用方式。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你把一本短篇隨筆集借給朋友，朋友最近只有零碎時間，擔心要趕着從頭讀完。你想寫借書便條，說各篇獨立，可自選幾篇分次讀，月底前再問是否需多借一周，不把它當功課。用一至兩句英文寫實際便條。

examples.en: This collection has independent essays, so you can dip in and out of it whenever you have a short gap. There is no reading assignment; let me know before the end of the month if another week would help.
examples.zh: 這本選集有獨立隨筆，所以有短空檔時，可不時回來讀。這不是閱讀功課；月底前若覺得多借一周有幫助，請告訴我。

examples.en: Feel free to dip in and out of it and choose the essays that interest you, rather than rush from the first page to the last. If you would like to keep the collection another week, could you ask me before this month ends?
examples.zh: 你可不時取來讀，選有興趣的隨筆，不用由首頁趕到尾頁。若想多借一周，可在本月底前問我嗎？

glossary.en: from the first page to the last

writing.selfCheckZh: 用借書便條提供可選分次閱讀及協商借期，保留it指已提隨筆集；不要求全讀，也不把借出變成沒有期限。

takeaways.en: The collection stayed on my desk so I could dip in and out of it between longer tasks.
takeaways.zh: 選集留在桌上，讓我在較長任務之間不時取來讀。

takeaways.en: She dipped in and out of it over the week, returning to the guide whenever a new question arose.
takeaways.zh: 那一周，她每遇新問題便回看指引，不時短暫取用。

lessons.titleEn: a whole bundle of little activities
lessons.titleZh: 集合在一起的許多小活動

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Social media offers a whole bundle of little activities.
sources.expression: a whole bundle of little activities

brief.meaningEn: A collection of many small activities considered together rather than one uniform action.
brief.meaningZh: 把許多小活動看成集合，而不是單一完全相同的動作。
brief.grammar: Offer/include/be a whole bundle of little activities. Bundle is figurative for a collection; whole adds emphasis, not a known count. Little concerns scale, not necessarily importance.
brief.boundaryZh: 小活動也可有不同目的及影響，不表示全部無關緊要，也不給每項同樣價值。
brief.misconceptionZh: 小活動也可有不同目的及影響，不表示全部無關緊要，也不給每項同樣價值。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「集合在一起的許多小活動」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 自然bundle集合圖像與little activities結合，不把整組當固定字典成語。

listening.en: For the club, the app offered a whole bundle of little activities: answering a question, adding a caption and checking an event time. Calling them all chatting would hide the different purposes of those small actions.
listening.zh: 對學會，程式集合許多小活動：回答問題、加圖說及查活動時間。全叫聊天，會隱藏那些小動作的不同目的。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 小動作雖在同程式，仍有不同用途。
三種動作都已確定只是聊天。
程式只供一次長篇考試，沒有短活動。
小活動已被定義為全部沒有重要性。

listening.explanationZh: question/caption/time 列不同用途，little 不取消實際意義。

reply.promptEn: Why did you avoid calling all the app use chatting?
reply.promptZh: 你為甚麼不把所有程式使用都叫聊天？

options.en: It was a whole bundle of little activities with different purposes, not one repeated action.
options.zh: 它集合許多目的不同的小活動，不是重複同一動作。

options.en: Some actions answered questions, while others added content or checked arrangements.
options.zh: 有些動作答問題，其他加內容或查安排。

options.en: One broad label would lose differences that mattered to the club’s work.
options.zh: 一個大標籤會漏掉學會工作所需的差別。

options.en: The size of an action did not tell us what it was for.
options.zh: 動作大小，沒有告訴我們它是為甚麼。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 記錄只說某人按過一次登入，沒有其他活動資料。作者想把它寫成已完成很多不同小任務。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: One login alone does not establish a whole bundle of little activities; we need to know what happened after entry.
options.zh: 單是一次登入，不能確立已做一整組小活動；需要知道進入後發生甚麼。

options.en: The record lists several captions, replies and timetable checks.
options.zh: 記錄列出幾項圖說、回覆及時間表核對。

options.en: Opening the app identifies all the purposes of the actions taken there.
options.zh: 打開程式，足以確定裏面所有動作的目的。

scene.explanationZh: 入口動作與之後實際用途不同，不能自行補上任務集合。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種理解不宜由 a whole bundle of little activities 得出？

options.en: 很多小活動被放在一起理解。
每項都必定不重要，而且目的完全一樣。
可分別問各活動服務甚麼需要。

contrast.explanationZh: 規模小不等於無意義，集合也不消除差異。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說小動作不值得分，統統叫娛樂即可；你想保留實際用途。哪句最好？

options.en: A whole bundle of little activities can include useful replies and arrangements as well as entertainment; let’s name what each action does.
options.zh: 一整組小活動可有實用回覆和安排，也有娛樂；讓我們指出各動作做甚麼。

options.en: I thought the short duration of each action was enough to classify it as entertainment.
options.zh: 我原以為每個動作時間短，已足以分類為娛樂。

options.en: I assumed adding a caption had the same purpose as checking an event time because both happened in the same app.
options.zh: 我以為加圖說和查活動時間發生在同一程式，所以目的也相同。

dialogue.explanationZh: 用途需看實際內容，不只按時長或所在程式。

speaking.en: It is a whole bundle of little activities, so could we choose the ones relevant to today’s question rather than treat them all alike?
speaking.zh: 它集合許多小活動，所以我們可否選跟今天問題相關的項目，不把全部當一樣？
speaking.promptZh: 協助小組選有關的小任務。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替地方歷史平台辦首次體驗，大家可替照片加地點、提出待查問題或回覆已知資料。你想寫開場邀請，讓參加者先選一項有興趣、願意做的小任務，不要求同時完成所有功能，也不把猜測當已知。用一至兩句英文寫實際開場白。

examples.en: The platform offers a whole bundle of little activities, but please begin with one you would like to try: a place label, a question or a reply supported by what you know. There is no need to do every task, and an uncertain detail can remain a question.
examples.zh: 平台集合許多小活動，但請先選一項想試的：加地點、提問題，或按所知回覆。不必每項都做，不確定細節可先保留成問題。

examples.en: We have a whole bundle of little activities for exploring the photographs, not a test of how many buttons you can use. Choose one contribution you are comfortable making, and tell us when a detail still needs checking.
examples.zh: 我們有許多探索照片的小活動，不是在考你會按多少按鈕。請選一項願意作的貢獻，並告訴我們哪個細節仍需核對。

glossary.en: one you would like to try

writing.selfCheckZh: 給出實際可選的入門任務及資料界線，不把集合當必做清單，也不按按鈕數量評價參與。

takeaways.en: Her diary described a whole bundle of little activities between classes, from confirming a room to replying to a classmate’s question.
takeaways.zh: 她的日記描述課間許多小活動，由確認房間到回覆同學問題。

takeaways.en: The researcher separated a whole bundle of little activities before asking which ones helped the group complete its plan.
takeaways.zh: 研究者先把許多小活動分開，再問哪些幫小組完成計劃。

lessons.titleEn: stay plugged into the wider world
lessons.titleZh: 持續連繫更廣闊的世界

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: News alerts help users stay plugged into the wider world.
sources.expression: stay plugged into the wider world

brief.meaningEn: Remain informed about or connected with events and people beyond one’s immediate routine.
brief.meaningZh: 持續了解或聯繫日常小圈子以外的人與事。
brief.grammar: Stay plugged into the wider world; plugged is a participle in an electrical connection image. News, letters or conversation can support the figurative connection; it need not mean constant device use.
brief.boundaryZh: 保持連繫不保證每則消息真確或全部時刻在線，也不等於知道所有事情。
brief.misconceptionZh: 保持連繫不保證每則消息真確或全部時刻在線，也不等於知道所有事情。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「持續連繫更廣闊的世界」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The weekly discussion helped me stay plugged into the wider world when my work kept me in the same building. We compared local and international stories, checking the source before treating a striking claim as established.
listening.zh: 工作令我常留同一大樓時，每周討論幫我連繫更廣闊世界。我們比較本地及國際故事，把醒目說法當確定前，先查來源。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 討論帶來圈外資訊，也保留查來源的需要。
討論已把引人注目的說法直接當成事實，沒有核對來源。
討論只重複大樓值班表，不談其他人與事。
說話者已決定必須整天開着設備才可參加。

listening.explanationZh: local/international/checking source 描述連繫及核實，不以plugged比喻作全天候設備要求。

reply.promptEn: How did the weekly discussion help beyond your normal routine?
reply.promptZh: 每周討論在日常小圈子以外怎樣幫你？

options.en: It helped me stay plugged into the wider world through stories beyond the building.
options.zh: 它透過大樓以外的故事，幫我連繫更廣闊世界。

options.en: The conversation brought local and international events into view.
options.zh: 談話讓我接觸本地及國際事件。

options.en: I could hear and question accounts I would not meet in the daily rota.
options.zh: 我可聽到並詢問日常輪值表以外的敘述。

options.en: It offered a regular connection while still asking us to check the claims.
options.zh: 它提供固定連繫，也仍要求我們核對說法。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 人物關掉電話通知，但每周讀報並與朋友討論其他地方的事情。旁人只因沒通知，就說她完全脫離世界。哪句較準確？

options.en: She can stay plugged into the wider world through reading and conversation without keeping every alert on.
options.zh: 她可透過閱讀及談話連繫更廣闊世界，不必開着每個通知。

options.en: The account says she has stopped reading news or discussing events outside her own routine.
options.zh: 敘述說她已停止讀新聞或談圈子以外事件。

options.en: Turning off notifications establishes that no information reaches her in any other form.
options.zh: 關通知足以確定，沒有資訊以任何其他形式到達她。

scene.explanationZh: 比喻關乎連繫，不只設備設定，仍有明確閱讀談話渠道。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 stay plugged into the wider world 得出？

options.en: 保持對圈外人與事的聯繫或了解。
每個通知都可靠，無須檢查。
可交代用了甚麼資訊或談話途徑。

contrast.explanationZh: 取得資訊與資訊已核實不同。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說要跟世界有聯繫，就不該關掉任何提醒；你仍想定時讀報。哪句最好？

options.en: I can stay plugged into the wider world through a chosen reading routine without responding to every alert immediately.
options.zh: 我可用自選閱讀習慣連繫更廣闊世界，不必立即回應每個提醒。

options.en: I thought the connection depended on accepting every notification the app offered.
options.zh: 我原以為這種連繫取決於接受程式提供的每個通知。

options.en: I assumed frequent alerts were a better sign of following events than a regular conversation about the news.
options.zh: 我以為提醒頻繁，比定期談新聞更能顯示自己有跟進時事。

dialogue.explanationZh: 連繫可以有選擇和核實，不由提醒頻率代替理解程度。

speaking.en: I want to stay plugged into the wider world through a few sources I can read carefully, rather than collect every possible alert.
speaking.zh: 我想透過幾個可仔細閱讀的來源連繫更廣闊世界，不是收集所有提醒。
speaking.promptZh: 說明選擇資訊來源的目的與範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替學生通訊邀請外地伙伴投稿，希望讀者不只看到自己校內的消息。你想請對方分享所在社區最近一項普通改變，註明地方及日期，也讓他自行選願意分享的內容，不把一人故事概括整個國家。用一至兩句英文寫實際邀請。

examples.en: Your contribution could help our readers stay plugged into the wider world beyond our own school. Would you share one recent everyday change in your community, naming the place and date and choosing only what you are comfortable making public?
examples.zh: 你的投稿可幫讀者連繫學校以外更廣闊的世界。你願意分享社區最近一項日常改變，註明地方和日期，只選自己願意公開的內容嗎？

examples.en: We hope the newsletter can help students stay plugged into the wider world through accounts from our partners elsewhere. Could you send a short local story with its place and date, so we can present it as your experience rather than a claim about your whole country?
examples.zh: 我們希望通訊透過外地伙伴的敘述，幫學生連繫更廣闊世界。你可否傳一則短地方故事，附地點及日期，讓我們呈現你的經驗，不把它當整個國家的說法？

writing.selfCheckZh: 寫具體而自願的投稿邀請，交代地點日期及個人經驗範圍，讓讀者接觸圈外生活；不把一位投稿者當整國代表。

takeaways.en: The monthly letters helped her stay plugged into the wider world beyond the work that occupied most of her days.
takeaways.zh: 每月書信幫她連繫更廣闊世界，不只限於佔去多數日子的工作。

takeaways.en: He stayed plugged into the wider world by comparing a few reports carefully, not by assuming the loudest alert told the whole story.
takeaways.zh: 他透過仔細比較幾份報道連繫更廣闊世界，不假定最響亮提醒就是全貌。

target.pattern: \bbuild(?:s|ing)? a personal brand\b|\bbuilt a personal brand\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: Artists may build a personal brand online.

brief.meaningEn: Develop a recognisable public identity around one’s work, qualities or expertise.
brief.meaningZh: 圍繞自己的工作、特點或專長，建立可被辨認的公開形象。
brief.grammar: Build a personal brand; built/building. A personal brand concerns how someone is presented and perceived, not simply a logo or all their private identity.
brief.boundaryZh: 形象清楚不保證能力、誠信或成功，也不要求捏造經歷或公開所有私事。
brief.misconceptionZh: 形象清楚不保證能力、誠信或成功，也不要求捏造經歷或公開所有私事。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「建立個人專業形象」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 常用於當代職涯與行銷的自然搭配，不保證建立形象帶來特定收入。

listening.en: The illustrator began to build a personal brand by showing how she developed simple characters and crediting the references she used. The profile made her approach recognisable, but clients still needed to examine the actual work.
listening.zh: 插畫師展示簡單角色怎樣發展，也列出所用參考，開始建立個人專業形象。個人頁讓做法較易辨認，但客戶仍需要看實際作品。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 她以工作方式建立可辨認形象，仍須看作品本身。
個人頁主要展示完成品，沒有讓人看到角色怎樣發展。
她只換私人姓名，沒有展示任何工作。
她主要靠改動頁面外觀建立形象，沒有標明參考來源。

listening.explanationZh: showing approach/crediting references 描述公開工作呈現，不等於能力已獲全面證明。

reply.promptEn: How did the illustrator make her working approach recognisable?
reply.promptZh: 插畫師怎樣讓工作方式可被辨認？

options.en: She began to build a personal brand through process examples and clear reference credits.
options.zh: 她透過過程例子及清楚參考鳴謝，開始建立個人專業形象。

options.en: The profile connected her public identity with the way she developed characters.
options.zh: 個人頁把公開形象跟角色發展方式連起來。

options.en: She showed a consistent approach instead of relying on a claim about talent alone.
options.zh: 她展示一致做法，不只靠有天分的聲稱。

options.en: People could recognise her process while still judging individual pieces.
options.zh: 大家可辨認她的過程，也仍逐件判斷作品。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 創作者只換了一個頁面顏色，沒有展示作品或說明工作方向。旁人想稱專業形象已全面建立。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: A colour change alone does not show how the creator has built a personal brand around identifiable work or expertise.
options.zh: 單改顏色，未顯示創作者怎樣圍繞可辨認作品或專長建立個人專業形象。

options.en: The account describes a series of work examples explaining the creator’s approach.
options.zh: 敘述描述一系列解釋創作做法的作品例子。

options.en: The new colour establishes both the creator’s expertise and what clients should expect from the work.
options.zh: 新顏色足以確定創作者的專長，以及客戶可期待甚麼工作。

scene.explanationZh: 視覺可參與形象，但單一改色不提供完整工作定位或專長證據。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 build a personal brand 得出？

options.en: 建立跟工作或特點相連的公開形象。
已保證客戶會選用其服務。
可問以哪些實際作品支持形象。

contrast.explanationZh: 公開呈現不是客戶選擇或成功的保證。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「如果我正在學一項新技術，建立個人形象時，是否只能把它寫成專長，否則就不該提？」你想提出誠實而有特色的呈現方法。哪句最好？

options.en: I can build a personal brand around work I can actually show, while describing the new technique as something I am still learning.
options.zh: 我可用實際能展示的工作建立形象，把新技術說成仍在學。

options.en: I thought an attractive profile needed every skill to be presented at the same expert level.
options.zh: 我原以為吸引的個人頁，要把每項技能都寫成相同專家水平。

options.en: I assumed the profile’s popularity was enough to show that clients could already rely on that new technique.
options.zh: 我以為個人頁受歡迎，已足以顯示客戶可依賴那項新技術。

dialogue.explanationZh: 誠實定位可有特色，不以聲量或形象代替具體能力。

speaking.en: I want to build a personal brand that reflects work I can explain, without turning every part of my private life into content.
speaking.zh: 我想建立能反映自己可解釋工作的個人形象，不把私生活每部分都變內容。
speaking.promptZh: 說明公開專業呈現與私人範圍。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你是學生攝影師，準備第一次作品頁。你想以「觀察普通街角」作清楚主題，放三張可解釋選景的作品，並說明哪些是已獲同意的人像；不把追蹤數或未做過的商業項目當經驗。用一至兩句英文給合作伙伴寫實際作品頁計劃。

examples.en: I would like to build a personal brand around noticing ordinary street corners, using three photographs whose framing I can explain. Let’s make the permissions for the portraits clear and describe only the work I have actually done.
examples.zh: 我想以觀察普通街角建立個人專業形象，用三張我能解釋構圖的照片。讓我們清楚說明人像同意，只描述實際做過的工作。

examples.en: To build a personal brand for this first portfolio, I suggest a focused street-corner theme rather than claims about commercial jobs I have not taken. The three examples can show my choices, with clear notes on the agreed portrait use.
examples.zh: 為首份作品集建立形象，我建議聚焦街角主題，不聲稱接過未做的商業工作。三個例子可展示選擇，並清楚註明已同意的人像用途。

writing.selfCheckZh: 提出有具體作品支持的清楚定位，準確交代人像用途及實際經驗；不以形象要求合理化誇大技能或公開私事。

takeaways.en: She built a personal brand through clear explanations of her repair work, while keeping clients’ private details out of the posts.
takeaways.zh: 她透過清楚解釋維修工作建立個人專業形象，也不把客戶私人資料放進貼文。

takeaways.en: He is building a personal brand around careful local research, but still invites readers to question the evidence in each article.
takeaways.zh: 他正圍繞仔細地方研究建立個人專業形象，也仍邀讀者質疑每篇文章的證據。

sources.sentence: Her profile became a shop window for her designs.

brief.meaningEn: A public-facing display that lets people see examples of someone’s work or products.
brief.meaningZh: 讓人看見某人作品或產品例子的公開展示面，借用商店櫥窗圖像。
brief.grammar: A profile can be/act as a shop window for designs or work. For identifies what is displayed. The image foregrounds presentation, not necessarily a place to order or a complete record of ability.
brief.boundaryZh: 展示不是已售出，也不一定列出所有作品；看得到例子仍可問過程及限制。
brief.misconceptionZh: 展示不是已售出，也不一定列出所有作品；看得到例子仍可問過程及限制。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「展示作品的公開櫥窗」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: Her profile became a shop window for her ceramic designs, showing a small selection with notes about the materials. It did not take orders directly; visitors had to contact her separately to discuss availability.
listening.zh: 她的個人頁成了陶瓷設計的展示櫥窗，列少量精選作品及材料說明。頁面不直接接單；訪客要另行聯絡她討論是否可供應。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 個人頁展示精選作品，訂購仍需另外聯絡。
頁面已自動接收每件展示品的訂單。
所有作品都已售完，沒有任何展示作用。
訪客不用聯絡，就已獲確認可供應的數量。

listening.explanationZh: selection/showing/contact separately 分開展示、供應和下單。

reply.promptEn: What role did her profile have for the designs?
reply.promptZh: 個人頁對她的設計有甚麼作用？

options.en: It was a shop window showing selected designs, not the place where orders were confirmed.
options.zh: 它是展示精選設計的櫥窗，不是確認訂單的地方。

options.en: People could see examples before contacting her about availability.
options.zh: 大家可先看例子，再聯絡問能否供應。

options.en: The page presented work while leaving a separate step for enquiries.
options.zh: 頁面呈現作品，也保留另外查詢的步驟。

options.en: It made the material and style visible without claiming every item was ready to buy.
options.zh: 它讓材料和風格可見，不聲稱每件都可立即購買。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 頁面只有已同意公開的成品照片，沒有製作過程或失敗試驗。讀者想把這當成完整工作檔案。哪句較準確？

options.en: A shop window can show selected work without being a complete record of how every piece developed.
options.zh: 櫥窗可展示精選作品，不一定是每件作品怎樣發展的完整記錄。

options.en: The account says the page includes every trial and revision in sequence.
options.zh: 敘述說頁面按序包括每次試驗及修訂。

options.en: Publishing finished photographs establishes that the development history is complete there too.
options.zh: 發布成品照片，足以確立該處也有完整發展經歷。

scene.explanationZh: 公開選集與完整過程記錄不同，沒有列出的細節不能自行補上。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a shop window for her work 得出？

options.en: 提供看作品例子的展示面。
每件展示品都已成交售出。
可再問哪些作品被選出及為何。

contrast.explanationZh: 櫥窗表示呈現，不是完成交易。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友問：「頁面像展示櫥窗，我看到喜歡的成品，是否就表示已有一份為我預留？」頁面只提供查詢方法，沒有訂購確認。哪句最好？

options.en: A shop window lets me see the work, but I still need to ask about availability and an order before assuming anything is reserved for me.
options.zh: 展示櫥窗讓我看作品，但假定已有物品為我預留前，我仍要詢問能否供應及怎樣訂購。

options.en: I thought seeing a finished design meant a copy was already reserved for me.
options.zh: 我原以為看見成品設計，就表示已為我預留一份。

options.en: I assumed the photograph showed an item currently in stock, rather than an example to enquire about.
options.zh: 我以為照片顯示的是現有存貨，不是供人查詢的作品例子。

dialogue.explanationZh: 展示照片不等於確認存貨或個人預留，仍應按頁面提供的方法查詢及確認訂購。

speaking.en: This page is a shop window for selected work, so could we add a clear route for enquiries rather than imply every item can be ordered here?
speaking.zh: 這頁是精選作品的展示櫥窗，所以可否加清楚查詢途徑，不暗示每件都可在此訂購？
speaking.promptZh: 向創作者建議分清展示及查詢。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校想公開你的修復作品，但照片有些屬客戶私人收藏，不全可刊。你要給負責人回覆，願意以兩件已同意公開的作品作展示，其他只留在私下評核，不把公開頁當全部能力檔案。用一至兩句英文提出有範圍的同意。

examples.en: I am happy for the page to be a shop window for the two repairs whose owners agreed to publication. Please keep the other photographs for the private assessment rather than treat a public selection as the whole portfolio.
examples.zh: 我願意讓頁面以兩件物主已同意公開的修復作品作展示櫥窗。其他照片請留作私下評核，不把公開選集當全部作品集。

examples.en: A shop window for my work can use the two approved examples without publishing every client’s object. I agree to that limited display, while the remaining material should stay within the assessment.
examples.zh: 展示我的工作，可用兩件已批准例子，不必公開每位客戶的物件。我同意那個有限展示，其餘材料仍應只用於評核。

writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚同意哪些可公開、哪些留在私下範圍，讓櫥窗作精選呈現而非全部檔案；不替未答應的物主公開。

takeaways.en: The open day was a shop window for the students’ designs, while a separate booklet explained the trials behind them.
takeaways.zh: 開放日是學生設計的展示櫥窗，另一本小冊才解釋背後試驗。

takeaways.en: Her website acted as a shop window, not a promise that each displayed piece was currently available.
takeaways.zh: 她的網站是展示櫥窗，不保證每件展示品當時都可供應。

sources.sentence: Social media can be a megaphone for local campaigns.

brief.meaningEn: A means of making a message reach a larger audience or gain greater attention.
brief.meaningZh: 令訊息傳到更多人或得到更大注意的工具，借用擴音器圖像。
brief.grammar: Social media can be/act as a megaphone for a message or cause. Amplification does not by itself identify truth, agreement or completed action.
brief.boundaryZh: 聲音放大不保證每人聽到、相信或行動，也可放大有誤內容；要核對實際回應。
brief.misconceptionZh: 聲音放大不保證每人聽到、相信或行動，也可放大有誤內容；要核對實際回應。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「把訊息放大的工具」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。

listening.en: The group used the page as a megaphone for the changed concert time, reaching people beyond the mailing list. We still asked for replies before claiming that every player had seen the update.
listening.zh: 小組把頁面當擴音器，放大更改演出時間的消息，接觸郵件名單以外的人；我們仍先等回覆，才說每位演出者都看過更新。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 訊息傳得較廣，但個別人是否看到仍需確認。
每位演出者已親自回覆確認看過。
頁面只存私人草稿，從未對外顯示。
小組只依靠原有郵件名單，沒有透過頁面接觸其他人。

listening.explanationZh: beyond list/still replies 分開擴散範圍與實際確認。

reply.promptEn: How did the page help the group communicate?
reply.promptZh: 頁面怎樣幫小組傳達訊息？

options.en: It acted as a megaphone for the new time beyond the mailing list.
options.zh: 它像擴音器，把新時間傳到郵件名單以外。

options.en: The public notice could reach people who were not on the original list.
options.zh: 公開通知可接觸原名單沒有的人。

options.en: It increased the audience without confirming each individual had read it.
options.zh: 它擴大觀眾，卻未確認每人已讀。

options.en: The group gained another way to make the change visible.
options.zh: 小組多一種讓改動可見的方式。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 一則關於舊橋落成年份的貼文被大量轉發，但原作者說仍未找到原始記錄核實。有人把轉發數當成日期已查證。哪句較準確？

options.en: The reposts act as a megaphone for the claim, but do not supply the missing evidence for the date.
options.zh: 轉發就像擴音器，放大了說法，卻沒有提供仍然缺少的年份證據。

options.en: The number of reposts establishes that the bridge’s original records have already been checked.
options.zh: 轉發數目足以確定，舊橋的原始記錄已經核對。

options.en: Because the date is unverified, the account says the claim has stayed within the original author’s page.
options.zh: 因為年份未核實，敘述說這個說法只留在原作者的頁面，沒有傳出去。

scene.explanationZh: 大量轉發可以放大未核實的說法，卻不能代替原始記錄；未查證也不表示訊息沒有傳開。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由 a megaphone for the message 得出？

options.en: 可放大訊息的接觸或注意。
每位收件者已同意並採取指定行動。
可再看實際誰收到或回覆。

contrast.explanationZh: 放大不等於人人同意或行動。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說貼文很熱門，就不用向未回覆隊員確認新時間；你想準確安排到場。哪句最好？

options.en: The page is a megaphone, not a reply from each player; let’s check with those we have not heard from.
options.zh: 頁面是擴音器，不是每位隊員的回覆；讓我們向未有消息的人確認。

options.en: I thought the total views already identified every player who had understood the change.
options.zh: 我原以為總瀏覽已確定每位理解改動的隊員。

options.en: I thought anyone who did not reply must have chosen not to play, because the notice was public.
options.zh: 我原以為通知已公開，任何沒回覆的人就必定選擇不演出。

dialogue.explanationZh: 具體到場安排需要個人回覆；公開聲量既不能確認已讀，也不能把沒回覆當選擇不演出。

speaking.en: A public page can be a megaphone for this correction, but we should make the new date clear rather than repeat the old mistake in the heading.
speaking.zh: 公開頁可放大這次更正，但應清楚寫新日期，不在標題重複舊錯誤。
speaking.promptZh: 向編輯提出公開更正要清楚的地方。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區市集原通知把開場日寫錯，已被多個帳號分享。現在你得到統籌確認的正確星期六，想直接回覆曾轉貼的人，請更新原貼文及附正確通知，不責怪對方，也不聲稱大家已看過更正。用一至兩句英文請求協助修正。

examples.en: Your page has been a megaphone for the market notice, so could you update the original post with the confirmed Saturday opening and link to the corrected announcement? Thank you for helping the correction reach the people who saw the earlier date.
examples.zh: 你的頁面曾放大市集通知，所以可否用已確認的星期六開場更新原貼文，並連到正確公告？謝謝你幫更正接觸曾看過舊日期的人。

examples.en: Could we use your page as a megaphone for the correction, with Saturday clearly stated and the organiser’s updated notice attached? I am asking for an update, not assuming everyone who saw the first post has already seen the change.
examples.zh: 我們可否用你的頁面放大更正，清楚寫星期六，附統籌人的更新通知？我是在請求更新，不是假定看過首篇的人都已看到改動。

writing.selfCheckZh: 直接、禮貌請求用同一渠道修正已擴散訊息，給清楚正確日期及來源；不把轉貼者當有惡意，也不把發布當所有人已知。

takeaways.en: The newsletter became a megaphone for the volunteers’ request, while the team still checked which replies offered actual help.
takeaways.zh: 通訊放大了義工請求，而團隊仍核對哪些回覆真能提供幫忙。

takeaways.en: A popular account can be a megaphone for an uncertain claim, which is why the editor asked for the source before sharing it.
takeaways.zh: 熱門帳號也可放大未確定說法，所以編輯在分享前問來源。

lessons.titleEn: light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next
lessons.titleZh: 看似輕巧，轉眼卻影響深遠

target.pattern: \blight as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next\b

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 2 to 9 Part 3.docx.pdf
sources.sentence: A post can be light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next.
sources.expression: light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next

brief.meaningEn: A post can seem casual at one point yet have an unexpectedly strong effect in another moment or response.
brief.meaningZh: 貼文一刻看來輕鬆隨意，另一刻或在某種回應中，卻產生出乎意料的強大作用。
brief.grammar: A post can be light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next. Parallel time phrases contrast perceived weight and effect; can keeps it possible, not a rule for every post.
brief.boundaryZh: 輕鬆不等於必定無影響，影響大也不保證好壞；要描述實際回應，不只用瀏覽量代替。
brief.misconceptionZh: 輕鬆不等於必定無影響，影響大也不保證好壞；要描述實際回應，不只用瀏覽量代替。
brief.outcomeZh: 理解「看似輕巧，轉眼卻影響深遠」的語境及用法，並在新情境寫出自然句子。
brief.sourceClassificationNote: 創意輕重對比，不把完整修辭句當固定成語；air 和 powerful 描寫感受與作用。

listening.en: Her joke about the closed hall was light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next, when former members shared why the place mattered. This was one response, not a rule that every joke starts a movement.
listening.zh: 她關於關閉禮堂的小笑話，一刻輕巧隨意，轉眼卻引起深遠回應：舊成員開始分享地方為何重要。作者描述這次回應，不說每個笑話都會帶起行動。
listening.promptZh: 先只聽示範句。說話者想表達甚麼？

options.en: 隨意笑話引出出乎意料的個人回應，敘述只限這次。
作者原先已計劃用笑話呼籲重開禮堂，舊成員的回憶只是照安排出現。
舊成員已先分享回憶，作者之後才用笑話回應那些故事。
舊成員已達成重開禮堂的具體協議。

listening.explanationZh: 小笑話原本輕鬆隨意，卻引出舊成員談論地方意義的回應，因而顯得更有分量。敘述沒有說已達成重開協議，也沒有把這個個案說成每則笑話的必然結果。

reply.promptEn: Why did the writer contrast the joke’s lightness with its later power?
reply.promptZh: 作者為甚麼對比笑話的輕巧及後來作用？

options.en: It was light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next because it prompted memories the writer had not expected.
options.zh: 它原本輕巧隨意，後來卻引出未料到的回憶，產生很大作用。

options.en: A casual beginning led to a much more meaningful response in this case.
options.zh: 在這個個案，隨意起點帶來更有意義的回應。

options.en: The effect was not apparent from the small joke alone.
options.zh: 單看小笑話，還看不出後來作用。

options.en: The contrast concerns how people responded, not only the post’s length.
options.zh: 對比關乎大家怎樣回應，不只貼文長短。

reply.explanationZh: 四種回應都能回答這個問題；含有本課表達的回應另外獲得金句標記。

scene.promptZh: 短貼文只有朋友表示笑過，沒有其他行動或意義描述。作者想由字數少直接確定已有深遠改變。哪句最謹慎？

options.en: To call it light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next, we would need an account of that stronger effect, not just a short text.
options.zh: 要說它由輕巧轉為出乎意料的強大作用，仍需描述較深影響，不只看短文。

options.en: The account reports former members organising a new project after reading it.
options.zh: 敘述報告舊成員讀後籌辦新項目。

options.en: The short length establishes that a major change followed the laughter.
options.zh: 字數短足以確定，笑過後發生重大改變。

scene.explanationZh: 強作用需要具體回應支持，不由長短自行推定。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種推論不宜由這個輕重對比得出？

options.en: 一則隨意內容可能引來未料到的作用。
每則幽默貼文都必然造成相同重大後果。
可用具體回應說明轉變。

contrast.explanationZh: 這個對比描述可能出現的意外作用，不是每則貼文都會產生重大後果的定律。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說玩笑不需考慮人怎樣回應，因為字少就是沒分量；你想保留內容與反應的關係。哪句最好？

options.en: A post can be light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next; I would look at the actual response rather than judge only its length.
options.zh: 貼文可由輕巧轉為出乎意料的強大作用；我會看實際回應，不只按字數判斷。

options.en: I thought a short joke could be understood only as entertainment, regardless of what readers described afterwards.
options.zh: 我原以為短笑話只可能是娛樂，不管讀者後來描述甚麼。

options.en: I assumed a short joke would matter less to readers than a longer formal post, without looking at their responses.
options.zh: 我以為短笑話對讀者的意義會比長篇正式貼文小，沒有看他們的回應。

dialogue.explanationZh: 短與隨意不排除意義，實際反應提供不同資料。

speaking.en: It was light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next, but I want to describe what people actually did rather than exaggerate the change.
speaking.zh: 它由輕巧轉為出乎意料的強大作用，但我想描述大家實際做甚麼，不誇大改變。
speaking.promptZh: 向編輯要求以實際行動支持鮮明修辭。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你把一段隨手寫的舊書笑話貼到班群，意外讓一位同學說出他在新校不敢開口借書的經驗。你想私下回覆，承認自己未料到這份意義，願意聽，但不把他的故事轉發作感人宣傳。用一至兩句英文寫實際訊息。

examples.en: That post felt light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next when you told me what it meant to you. Thank you for trusting me; I am happy to listen, and I will not share your story with the group without asking.
examples.zh: 你說出貼文對你的意義時，它由隨意輕巧，轉為出乎意料的重要。謝謝你信任我；我願意聽，未問過你不會把故事分享到班群。

examples.en: It was light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next for me, because your response showed a meaning I had not imagined. If you want to say more, I will listen privately rather than turn your experience into a public example.
examples.zh: 對我來說，它一刻輕巧隨意，轉眼卻十分有分量，因你的回應展示我未想到的意義。如果你想多說，我會私下聽，不把經驗變公開例子。

writing.selfCheckZh: 直接回應當事人分享的具體意義及信任，保留私下聆聽與先問同意；不把個人回應誇成社群運動或公開故事素材。

takeaways.en: The caption was light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next when the former teacher recognised the place and offered a different memory.
takeaways.zh: 舊老師認出地方並提出另一段回憶時，輕巧圖說忽然產生出乎意料的重要作用。

takeaways.en: A post can be light as air one moment and surprisingly powerful the next, as her account of an unexpected conversation shows.
takeaways.zh: 她記下的一場意外談話顯示，貼文可從輕巧隨意轉為出乎意料的有分量。
